scope: Append-only DSBI TRAIN context preparation; no training, inference, validation selection or test pixels.
image_transform_before_crop: Identity on provided already deskewed +recto.jpg; JPEG decode to RGB; never reapply annotation angle.
cell_box: Full two-column/three-row grid, .3 horizontal column pitch extension on every edge.

positive_anchor_policy.row_bands: Listed slots in row/column order; span determined only by source ordinal, one-based row and band ordinal.
positive_anchor_policy.context_width: max(anchor union width + two horizontal pitches, 3.2 * maximum full cell height)
positive_anchor_policy.pixel_crop_rounding: floor left/top; ceil right/bottom after fitting the complete rectangle inside the source image

unlisted_slots: Separate transformed full ignore_boxes; never positive objectness/geometry/dots.
explicit_zero_masks: Retained in source ledger as background, excluded from positive boxes/masks.
empty_recto_side: Nine fixed contexts at 20/50/80 percent x/y; 320x128 source pixels, bounded if needed; justified only by documented empty side annotation.
originally_complete: Compare the full original source box to the bounded integer source crop before resize, with exact inequalities and no restoration tolerance. Crops remain inside the original deskewed raster.
